name: Operating System Control
description: Tools for interacting with and controlling the operating system.
progressive_guidance: Read occupied destinations; patch updates without changing unrelated content. A requested output path does not authorize discarding its contents: save an exact, unique recoverable copy before full replacement, including shell writes. Resolve ordinary collisions without owner confirmation. Verify the new output and preserved bytes before completion; retain and briefly report the saved copy. If evidence is missing, verify or recover with tools.
